caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered against a plain, beige background. The object is a flat, silhouette-like figure of a winged person, resembling an angel, shown in a horizontal flying position facing left. The figure is playing a long trumpet held in both hands, with the trumpet directed outward. The wings are spread wide, with distinct feather details. The colors are predominantly shades of dull yellow, rusted brown, green, and hints of bluish-gray, suggesting a weathered metallic appearance with patches of oxidation and wear across its surface. The head, arms, wings, and legs of the figure are clearly defined by the outline, and there are traces of red at the head, arm joints, and legs which contribute to the aged effect. The background is unadorned, making the winged figure the only subject of the composition.
title: Gabriel Weather Vane
